description: Historical ICLR acceptance rate for papers with similar reviewer ratings, from public OpenReview decisions (kernel estimate over past score profiles). Give 3–6 ratings on the 0–10 scale ICLR used through 2026 (even numbers 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10; 2024–2025 used 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10). ICLR 2027 ratings are on a new 1–4 scale (clear reject, leaning reject, leaning accept, clear accept) with no acceptance history yet, so do not pass 2027 ratings here. Not a prediction of any decision.

scores.description: Reviewer ratings on the 0–10 scale (ICLR 2026 and earlier), e.g. [6, 6, 8, 4].

name: iclr_acceptance_odds
title: ICLR acceptance odds from review scores
